title.narrative: Enhancing Access to Climate Finance for Ethiopia

description.narrative: GGGI has identified essential gaps that need to be addressed to improve Ethiopia’s access to climate finance. GGGI has a close working relationship with the Ministry of Finance and other Ministries, which allows it to select the actions with largest impacts. By emphasizing the issues of finance mobilization capacity within the Government of Ethiopia (GoE), transparency of existing and future, national and regional, finance flows, and the carbon pricing framework, the project will bring climate finance in Ethiopia to a new level.
